meta.name: analyze-codebase
meta.description: Analyze an existing repository in read-only mode to reconstruct current behavior, architecture, dependency clusters, build and test health, hotspots, tech debt, ownership boundaries, integration points, and current-vs-target gaps. Use for existing-product improvement, migration planning, code archaeology, risky refactors, unfamiliar repositories, or artifacts `80-current-state-scan.md` through `85-migration-plan.md` before writing code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 读懂现有代码摸清架构与隐患
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果面对陌生仓库需要快速掌握现状和规划改造
copy.tagline_en: Understand existing code to reveal architecture, risks, and migration paths.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you face an unfamiliar codebase and need to grasp its state and plan changes.

howto.what: Claude 会以只读方式分析现有代码库,理清架构、依赖和构建测试情况。它产出当前状态扫描、热点与技术债务清单、目标差距笔记和迁移计划输入,并标注高风险文件。
howto.when: 当用户要求分析现有仓库、规划迁移或重构不熟悉的代码库时触发;也用于写代码前检查当前状态与目标差距。

say.text: 分析这个代码库,输出当前架构摘要。
say.note: 触发只读扫描并生成地图。

say.text: 找出技术债务和热点文件。
在改代码前,先给出迁移风险清单。
say.note: 确保写代码前先做分析。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes an existing codebase in read-only mode, mapping structure, dependencies, build/test health, hotspots, tech debt, and current-vs-target gaps. It produces artifacts like current-state scan, codebase map, migration risks, and flags high-risk areas.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to analyze an existing repo, plan a migration, or refactor unfamiliar code, or before writing code to compare current state with a target.

say_en.text: Analyze this codebase and output an architecture summary.
say_en.note: Runs a read-only scan and produces a map.

say_en.text: Find tech debt and hotspot files.
Before editing, give a migration risk list.
say_en.note: Ensures analysis happens before code changes.
